finding.method: git log --format=%h --all -- <path> enumerated every committed version; git rev-list --all --objects confirms the pinned shas are absent from the object database

consequence_for_the_universal_learning_c: 8 of 10 bindings verify. The contract's evidence base is therefore 8/10, not 10/10. No acceptance credit may be drawn from the two unsatisfiable bindings.
